title: Salah in negotiations with Trabzonspor after leaving Liverpool
seoTitle: Salah in talks with Trabzonspor after leaving Liverpool
subtitle: 34-year-old Egyptian striker negotiates move to Black Sea coast club
excerpt: On August 4, 2026, Mohamed Salah, who left Liverpool after nine seasons, is negotiating with Turkish club Trabzonspor, which has seven national titles.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On August 4, 2026, Egyptian striker Mohamed Salah, 34, is in negotiations to join Trabzonspor on a free transfer, after ending his spell at Liverpool at the end of last season.

Recent history of Salah at Liverpool

Salah arrived at Liverpool from Roma in June 2017 and stayed nine seasons, accumulating 442 appearances. During that period, he won two Premier League titles, the Champions League, the FIFA Club World Cup, the UEFA Super Cup, the FA Cup, two EFL Cups and the Community Shield.

Individual achievements of Salah

The striker won the Premier League Golden Boot four times and was named the Professional Footballers' Association Player of the Year in 2018, 2022 and 2025. In numbers, he scored 257 goals and provided 120 assists for the English club.

Participation of Salah in the 2026 World Cup

Representing Egypt, Salah reached the round of 16 of the 2026 World Cup, being eliminated 3-2 by Argentina, which ended up as a finalist.

Tradition and titles of Trabzonspor

Trabzonspor, known as the Black Sea Storm, is based in the northeastern city of Trabzon and has already won seven Turkish Süper Lig titles, six of them between 1976 and 1984. The club is part of the exclusive group of six teams that have lifted the national league trophy.

Details of the negotiation

The club said that information about the welcome program for the new player will be released to the public through its official channels throughout the day.

With information from BBC Sport.
